talkToElena.text: Talk to Elena in her house west of the northern Ardougne bank.

talkToJerico.text: Talk to Jerico in his house south of the northern Ardougne bank

talkToOmartToEnterWestArdougne.text: Talk to Omart, south of the watchtower, to enter West Ardougne.

talkToTheChemist.text: Take the Plague Sample to the Chemist in Rimmington. You can take a boat from Ardougne Dock to Rimmington for 30gp.

returnToElenaAfterSampling.text: Return to Elena and inform her that the plague is a hoax.
